note: Step 4 motion model (guide 4.1.5, 4.1.6, 4.2). Read by src/motion.py; the step-5 generator uses the same file. Values: guide 4.2, measured ones from reports/step4/gyro.json and trail_check_*.txt.

windows.max_rate_note: applied within +-0.3 s of the exposure mid only (a +-1.2 s limit dropped 6% of the 16 Oct windows, the violent ones)
windows.note: real gyro windows (+-half_s: room for a 4x speed-up and the time shifts) around real exposure mids, camera frame, offset = mean over +-150 s. 16 Oct = the rough night (long, curved trails). Step 5 splits windows by run/time between train/val/test.

synthetic_share.note: a fraction of the windows is sped up (rate x factor, time compressed) to cover long trails and sharp speed changes (guide 4.1.5)

true_motion.interp: PCHIP through the real samples, 1 ms steps (a cubic spline overshoots: +17% length on 16 Oct)
true_motion.vibration_note: true-only sinusoidal jitter along a random direction (guide 4.1.6); NOT in the gyro channel

rolling_shutter.note: not measured (step 4 part 1: slope not significant)

gyro_errors.note: tau = error of the time after the nominal correction (guide 4.2.3: spread +-20 ms = 2 sigma, plus outliers). white noise: measured upper bound 0.034-0.042 deg/s (gyro.json). Sampling: real interval sequences drawn from the same run (guide 4.2.6); linear interpolation of the samples (the live code must use the same).

patch.note: channel 2 mid-time point at the patch centre (corner coords). A trail whose measured path reaches > max_extent_px from its mid-time point is rejected (flagged), see WORKLOG step 4.
